g.text: State-dependent recovery thresholds and later recovery
Left: every release dose and source at +1 h. Right: worst gap across all doses in both families.
Throttle family: zero gap at every dose/time. All 162 branches: zero gap at +3 and +5 h. Full numerical atlas retained in measurements.
Black segments mark adjacent recovery transitions. A zero gap is specific to the one-hour reserve task and stated business budget.
